caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug with a rounded body, a flared base, and a decorative handle featuring several curves and loops. The mug is rendered in shades of gray, with shading used to indicate its three-dimensional form and reflectivity. On the left side near the lower portion, there is a faintly inscribed text that appears to be on the mug itself. In the lower left corner of the page, there is a rectangular inset drawing showing a ribbon with text, likely an award designation, mentioning the Albany Agricultural Society and "Best Ruta Baga." In the upper right corner, there is a smaller rectangle with a simplified outline of the mug, labeled with the number "5" indicating height in inches, and showing proportions in a more technical style. The main background is plain and light in color, and the artist's name, "G.P. Sanborn," is signed in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Mug
